00119     //inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) const throw()
00120     static inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) throw()
00121     {
00122         vFloat *InReal1 = (vFloat *) In1.realp;
00123         vFloat *InImag1 = (vFloat *) In1.imagp;
00124         vFloat *InReal2 = (vFloat *) In2.realp;
00125         vFloat *InImag2 = (vFloat *) In2.imagp;
00126         vFloat *OutReal = (vFloat *) Out.realp;
00127         vFloat *OutImag = (vFloat *) Out.imagp;
00128         ZEROINIT
00129         
00130         float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00131         Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00132         Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00133         
00134         In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00135         In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00136         
00137         Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00138         
00139         for (int i = 0; i < VecLength; i++)
00140         {
00141             OutReal[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutReal[i], VEC_SUB_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG)));
00142             OutImag[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutImag[i], VEC_ADD_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG)));
00143         }
00144         
00145         In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00146         In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00147     }
00148     
00149     //inline vFloat vecSplat (float splatval) const throw()
00150     static inline vFloat vecSplat (float splatval) throw()
00151     {
00152         vFloat ReturnVec;
00153         float *ReturnFloat = (float *) &ReturnVec;
00154         ReturnFloat[0] = splatval;
00155         ReturnFloat[1] = splatval;
00156         ReturnFloat[2] = splatval;
00157         ReturnFloat[3] = splatval;
00158                 
00159         return ReturnVec;
00160     }
00161     
00162     
00163 protected:

00168

00170     int partitionsDone, scheduleCounter, lastPart, validPart;
